newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain Meff lowers coupon on Bono future to 6.5 pct.
newsitem.headline: Spain Meff lowers coupon on Bono future to 6.5 pct.

text.p: Spain's fixed-income futures exchange Meff will reduce the nominal coupon on its 10-year bond future to 6.5 percent from nine percent as of December, Meff said on Wednesday.

"The change responds to the need to adapt to the Euro but achieves a double objective. The first is to adapt the contract to the new reality of Spain's economy...and the gradual reduction in interest rates. It also allows MEFF to face with its traditional efficiency the competitive situation that European economic and monetary union means to organised derivatives markets," Meff said in a statement.
